title: 第459章 找上牛克长老第458章 聂小灵求助
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
短短片刻，所有淤积的旧疾尽数被修复。
陈阳缓缓收回手掌，轻声说：“好了。”
聂小灵立刻仔细感知自身状态，发现常年伴随的头部不适彻底消失，头脑清明通透，浑身轻松舒展。
仿佛卸下了压在身上多年的千斤重担，整个人的精气神都焕然一新。
她满眼感激地看向陈阳，真诚道谢：“太谢谢你了，陈少！”
陈阳微微摇头，语气随和：“不用客气。”
聂小灵像是忽然想到什么，眼底一亮，立刻抬手从纳戒中取出一只精致的小丹瓶，递到陈阳面前，认真说：“陈少，这里还有两枚半仙品强体丹，你务必收下。”
陈阳连忙推辞：“不用了，我刚刚已经收下你十枚丹药，不用再给我了。”
聂小灵态度真诚且坚定，认真道：“之前的丹药，是感谢你治好我弟弟的腿疾。
这两枚丹药，是我专门用来感谢你刚刚治好我多年头疾的酬劳，两码事，你不用跟我客气。”
陈阳见聂小灵态度格外坚决，没有半分推脱的余地，就不再推辞，淡淡应声：“行，那我就收下了。”
他抬手接过那只精致的丹瓶，指尖轻转，直接将丹药收进了自己的纳戒之中，动作利落干脆。
聂小灵这时看着他脸，不知为何，心头莫名一动，心底泛起一丝微妙的涟漪，白皙的脸颊悄悄晕开一层淡淡的绯红，温婉的眉眼也柔和了几分。
突然，陈阳的目光不经意扫过来。
她心头微慌，连忙轻轻偏过头，装作眺望窗外的街景，悄悄掩饰住自己脸上的羞涩与悸动。
车队一路疾驰，平稳赶路，转眼就到了正午时分。
烈日高悬，山间林木葱郁，绿意盎然，燥热的山风轻轻吹拂。
三辆黑色豪车稳稳停在黄石山山脚一处僻静的石洞旁。
一行人陆续下车，聂小灵踩着微凉的山石路面停下脚步，抬手指向前方黑漆漆的石洞入口，转头对着陈阳认真说：“陈少，就是这里了。”
陈阳抬眸看向幽深的石洞，洞口岩石粗糙斑驳，周遭灵气凝滞，气场阴沉，他轻轻点了点头，神色平静淡然。

石洞门口，一名看守的年轻弟子立刻注意到了一行人。
他身形极其高大壮硕，浑身肌肉虬结，线条硬朗，古铜色的肌肤透着满满的力量感，宽厚的背脊上斜背着一柄厚重的巨型战斧。
斧身寒光凛冽，看着极具威慑力。
见到聂小灵一行人到来，他眼神一凛，不敢怠慢，立刻转身快步冲进石洞内部通风报信。
没过片刻，方才那名壮硕青年快步折返而出，身后跟着一名身着灰布长衫的老者。
老者面容干瘪，皱纹遍布脸颊，眉眼狭长锐利，眼底藏着常年身居高位的傲慢与冷厉，周身萦绕着浑厚沉稳的灵力气息。
气场十足，正是成仙门长老牛克。
牛克缓步走出洞口，目光径直落在聂小灵身上，语气带着几分居高临下的淡漠与戏谑：“聂小姐，这个月的供奉丹药，你倒是来得挺早。”
面对气场强横的牛克，聂小灵心底莫名涌上一股紧绷的紧张感，下意识屏住呼吸，身姿微微一僵。
content_en:
In just a few moments, all the accumulated old diseases were repaired.
Chen Yang slowly retracted his palm and said softly: "Okay."
Nie Xiaoling immediately carefully sensed his own condition and found that the head discomfort that had been associated with him for many years had completely disappeared, his mind was clear and transparent, and his whole body was relaxed and relaxed.
It was as if a heavy burden that had been weighing on me for many years had been lifted off, and my whole body was refreshed.
She looked at Chen Yang with grateful eyes and thanked her sincerely: "Thank you so much, Mr. Chen!"
Chen Yang shook his head slightly and said in an easy-going tone: "You're welcome."
Nie Xiaoling seemed to have suddenly thought of something, his eyes lit up, and he immediately raised his hand to take out an exquisite small elixir bottle from the ring, handed it to Chen Yang, and said seriously: "Mr. Chen, there are two semi-immortal grade body-strengthening elixirs here, you must accept them."
Chen Yang quickly declined: "No, I have just accepted ten pills from you, you don't need to give them to me anymore."
Nie Xiaoling's attitude was sincere and firm, and he said seriously: "The elixir I gave you earlier was to thank you for curing my brother's leg disease.
These two pills are my special reward for curing my head ailment that I have suffered for many years. They are two different things, so you don’t have to be polite to me. "
Seeing that Nie Xiaoling's attitude was particularly determined and there was no room for evasion, Chen Yang stopped refusing and responded calmly: "Okay, then I'll accept it."
He raised his hand to take the delicate elixir bottle, turned his fingertips lightly, and directly put the elixir into his Najie, with a neat movement.
Nie Xiaoling looked at his face at this time. For some reason, his heart moved inexplicably, and a subtle ripple appeared in his heart. A faint blush quietly appeared on his fair cheeks, and his gentle eyebrows softened a bit.
Suddenly, Chen Yang's eyes glanced over inadvertently.
She was slightly panicked and quickly turned her head slightly, pretending to look out the window at the street scene, quietly covering up the shyness and throbbing on her face.
The convoy galloped along smoothly, and it was noon in the blink of an eye.
The scorching sun is high, the mountains are lush and green, and the hot mountain wind is blowing gently.
Three black luxury cars were parked steadily next to a secluded cave at the foot of Yellowstone Mountain.
The group of people got out of the car one after another. Nie Xiaoling stopped on the cool rocky road, raised his hand and pointed to the dark entrance of the cave in front, turned to Chen Yang and said seriously: "Young Master Chen, this is it."
Chen Yang raised his eyes and looked at the deep cave. The rocks at the entrance were rough and mottled, the surrounding spiritual energy was stagnant, and the aura was gloomy. He nodded gently, his expression calm and indifferent.
At the entrance of the cave, a young disciple guarding the cave immediately noticed the group of people.
He was extremely tall and strong, with muscles all over his body and strong lines. His bronze skin exuded a sense of strength, and he carried a heavy giant battle ax slanted on his broad back.
The ax body has a cold light and looks very intimidating.
When he saw Nie Xiaoling and his entourage arriving, his eyes sharpened and he did not dare to neglect. He immediately turned around and rushed into the cave to report the news.
After a while, the sturdy young man from before quickly turned back, followed by an old man wearing a gray cloth gown.
The old man's face was shriveled, with wrinkles all over his cheeks. His eyebrows were narrow and sharp, and his eyes contained the arrogance and coldness of having been in a high position for many years. There was a strong and steady aura of spiritual power lingering around him.
Full of aura, he is none other than Niu Ke, the elder of Chengxian Sect.
Niu Ke slowly walked out of the cave, his eyes fell directly on Nie Xiaoling, his tone was a bit condescending and indifferent and joking: "Miss Nie, you came quite early to offer the elixir this month."
Facing the tyrannical Niu Ke, Nie Xiaoling felt an inexplicable sense of tension in her heart. She subconsciously held her breath and stiffened slightly.
